verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fellow serves a proper llms.txt file at https://developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) summarizing its API for agent consumption, and the broader developer docs (API reference, MCP server docs) are structured for both human and agent use. Missing for 10: no evidence of a companion llms-full.txt or independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume this file in practice.
